\paragraph{Operating constraints and evidence.} 
% Shared source: ANT-EPS-FR-001
The EPS must sustain the scheduled mission loads with the 25 Wh planning battery across representative launch-dependent RAAN and eclipse cases, without an accumulating energy deficit. Corrected annual solar/load integrals are 50288.809/30866.103 Wh; runtime and EOL identity unresolved.
% Shared source: ANT-EPS-FR-002
The EPS must keep battery energy within selected-cell operating and depth-of-discharge limits during startup, science, Relay and Safe Mode. Numerical SOC/DoD limits remain open allocations. Corrected annual minimum 15.097556 Wh; actual capacity and supplier limits unknown.

% Shared source: ANT-EPS-FR-003
The EPS must supply simultaneous and transient load demand within bus voltage, current and ripple allocations, including payload acquisition, radio transmit and actuator peaks. These limits remain open allocations. Mode loads exist; qualified peaks and bus limits absent.
% Shared source: ANT-EPS-FR-004
The EPS must generate the allocated Sun-Pointing energy using the fixed +Z panel and two deployed panels, with illumination, pointing and conversion losses explicitly accounted for. Configuration defined; generating and deployed-area identities differ.

% Shared source: ANT-EPS-FR-005
The EPS must reserve energy for detumble, safe-state survival and recovery until the next usable generation opportunity; maximum recovery duration and energy reserve remain open allocations. One 2460 s detumble event; left-held load integral 1.528000 Wh; reserve not allocated.
% Shared source: ANT-EPS-FR-006
The EPS must maintain the mission energy allocation through the approximately five-year operations objective using traceable EOL degradation and cycling assumptions. EOL study inputs exist; average generation is not an EOL margin.

\paragraph{Feasibility assessment.} The array/battery architecture provides an analysis basis, not a closed margin. The 25 Wh planning value is not an allowed depth-of-discharge limit. Allocate startup reserve, bus peaks and worst-RAAN/EOL depletion at concept review; verify component aging and transients at PDR.
